description:
See a section: one image of its screenshot tiles stitched top to bottom (every part of a long section), its long edge at most max_px. Use it to judge a section by its pixels before you choose, describe or build from it: the summary is one line. context_px adds that many page px of the sections above and below, from the same capture, with thin magenta lines where the section starts and ends. from_px/to_px show only part of it (section px, 0 = its top), such as a text block's rect from get_section, larger; the image is never scaled past the tiles' own resolution (page.dsf×). The text result maps image px back to page px.
Positions are from our capture of the page (page.shotAt, page.viewport, usually 1440×900), not today's live page: y is CSS px from the top of the captured page.

context_px.description: Page px of the neighbouring sections to show above and below (default 0).

from_px.description: Show the section from here, section px (default: its top).

max_px.description: Long edge of the image, px (default 1568).

search_id.description: Optional: the searchId of the search you got this from, so we learn which results were useful.

to_px.description: Show the section down to here, section px (default: its bottom).
